propositions: Per-unit Pandoc conversion invokes _pandoc_timeout() on every unit, causing load_config() to execute repository-root discovery via git rev-parse --show-toplevel redundantly for each of 884 units.

Moving timeout resolution from per-unit to once per render pass, threading it through optional parameters to _render_unit and _convert, reduces git-root subprocesses from 886 to 3 while preserving all 884 real Pandoc calls and byte-identical outputs.

Held-out behavioral oracle with three renderable units must assert exactly one _pandoc_timeout() resolution per render pass; direct callers and test monkeypatches must accept optional timeout parameter with safe defaults.

Fresh 884-unit trace must measure exactly 887 total subprocesses (884 Pandoc + 3 cold git-root probes) and preserve byte-equivalence to all expected outputs, timeout configurability, per-unit fallback, and process-group reap behavior.
